schema.name: intent-router
schema.description: Send each assistant request to one of many intents or tools, and flag whether it needs the user's own account.
schema.state: One user request to an in-app assistant, as text.

intent.instructions: Which intent or tool should handle this request?

criteria.card_not_arrived: A new or replacement card has not arrived yet.
criteria.activate_card: How to activate a card that has arrived.
criteria.card_lost_or_stolen: The card is lost, stolen or may be compromised.
criteria.card_payment_declined: A card payment was declined or failed.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment the user does not recognise.
criteria.contactless_not_working: Contactless or tap-to-pay does not work.
criteria.change_pin: Change, reset or unblock the card PIN.
criteria.atm_cash_problem: An ATM withdrawal went wrong, such as no cash or the wrong amount.
criteria.top_up_failed: Adding money to the account failed.
criteria.top_up_pending: A top-up is still pending or has not arrived.
criteria.transfer_not_received: A sent transfer has not reached the recipient.
criteria.transfer_failed: A transfer failed or came back.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancel a transfer that was already sent.
criteria.add_payee: Add, edit or trust a payee or beneficiary.
criteria.exchange_rate: The exchange rate applied or offered.
criteria.fee_question: Why a fee was charged, or what a service costs.
criteria.refund_not_showing: A merchant refund has not appeared yet.
criteria.request_refund: The user wants money back from a merchant.
criteria.direct_debit_issue: An unknown, failed or wrong direct debit.
criteria.verify_identity: Identity checks, documents or selfie verification.
criteria.update_personal_details: Change name, address, phone number or email.
criteria.statement_request: A statement, proof of balance or transaction export.
criteria.balance_not_updated: The balance did not update after a transfer or deposit.
criteria.mobile_wallet: Apple Pay, Google Pay or paying with a phone or watch.
criteria.virtual_card: Create or use a virtual or disposable card.
criteria.spending_limits: Card or account limits and how to change them.
criteria.savings_interest: Savings accounts, interest rates or savings pots.
criteria.fraud_or_scam: The user thinks they were scammed or someone else used their account.
criteria.app_login_problem: Cannot log in to the app, passcode or new-device problems.
criteria.talk_to_human: The user asks for a person or an agent.

needs_account_access.instructions: Does handling this request require looking at or changing the user's own account, cards or transactions?

criteria.true: The request is about the user's own money, cards, payments or personal data.
criteria.false: A general question that public product information can answer.

samples.state: I ordered a new card 10 days ago and it still hasn't shown up. Can I track it?
there's a payment of 79.99 from DGTL*STRMSVC on my card that I never made
What rate do you use to convert pounds to euros at the weekend?
I sent £300 to my landlord yesterday and he says it hasn't arrived. Can you check where it is?
Got a text saying my account was frozen and I read them the code you sent me. Now £1,200 is gone. HELP
can I pay with my watch?

# Tez schema (format: docs/API.md, "Schema files"). Gallery example for a digital-banking assistant.
# More than 26 options: zero-shot letters run a chunked tournament (several passes); a trained probe answers in one pass.
name: intent-router
description: Send each assistant request to one of many intents or tools, and flag whether it needs the user's own account.
state: "One user request to an in-app assistant, as text."
questions:
  intent:
    type: choice
    instructions: Which intent or tool should handle this request?
    criteria:
      card_not_arrived: A new or replacement card has not arrived yet.
      activate_card: How to activate a card that has arrived.
      card_lost_or_stolen: The card is lost, stolen or may be compromised.
      card_payment_declined: A card payment was declined or failed.
      card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment the user does not recognise.
      contactless_not_working: Contactless or tap-to-pay does not work.
      change_pin: Change, reset or unblock the card PIN.
      atm_cash_problem: An ATM withdrawal went wrong, such as no cash or the wrong amount.
      top_up_failed: Adding money to the account failed.
      top_up_pending: A top-up is still pending or has not arrived.
      transfer_not_received: A sent transfer has not reached the recipient.
      transfer_failed: A transfer failed or came back.
      cancel_transfer: Cancel a transfer that was already sent.
      add_payee: Add, edit or trust a payee or beneficiary.
      exchange_rate: The exchange rate applied or offered.
      fee_question: Why a fee was charged, or what a service costs.
      refund_not_showing: A merchant refund has not appeared yet.
      request_refund: The user wants money back from a merchant.
      direct_debit_issue: An unknown, failed or wrong direct debit.
      verify_identity: Identity checks, documents or selfie verification.
      update_personal_details: Change name, address, phone number or email.
      close_account: Close the account.
      statement_request: A statement, proof of balance or transaction export.
      balance_not_updated: The balance did not update after a transfer or deposit.
      mobile_wallet: Apple Pay, Google Pay or paying with a phone or watch.
      virtual_card: Create or use a virtual or disposable card.
      spending_limits: Card or account limits and how to change them.
      savings_interest: Savings accounts, interest rates or savings pots.
      fraud_or_scam: The user thinks they were scammed or someone else used their account.
      app_login_problem: Cannot log in to the app, passcode or new-device problems.
      talk_to_human: The user asks for a person or an agent.
      other: None of the above.
  needs_account_access:
    type: noul
    instructions: Does handling this request require looking at or changing the user's own account, cards or transactions?
    criteria:
      "true": The request is about the user's own money, cards, payments or personal data.
      "false": A general question that public product information can answer.
